title: Returns and Disputes
meta: Returns, cases and buyer messages handled calmly in your eBay account, with clear replies. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: eBay returns and disputes, handled calmly
overview: A returns case can hurt your seller level if it is handled badly. We read each open return, case and buyer message in your eBay account, draft clear and polite replies, collect the evidence like tracking and photos, and tell you the best next step under eBay's rules. You approve anything involving money. We also tidy your return policy, so fewer cases start. Outcomes are decided by eBay and the buyer.

pkgs.blurb: Open cases reviewed with replies drafted.
More cases handled, plus a return policy that fits your items.
A full cases desk, with an evidence kit and prevention plan.

faq: We cannot promise outcomes, because eBay and the buyer decide. We make sure your side is told clearly, with the right proof, in time. That gives you the best fair chance.
Only with your say-so. We prepare the case, and you set a limit for refunds we may issue. For any amount above it, we ask you first. We never touch your payout settings.
What if the buyer is dishonest?
We stay factual, collect the proof and use the steps eBay provides to report it. We do not threaten, argue or take the matter outside eBay, since that can put your account at risk.
We cannot stop all of them, but we look for patterns in your cases, such as sizing, damage in transit or unclear photos, and list fixes to your listings and packing so fewer cases start.
